high.title: AI FULL STACK Developer
high.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated AI Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications powered by modern AI/LLM technologies.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the frontend, backend, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML integration layer. You should be able to take an AI-powered product feature from concept to production.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop end-to-end web applications with AI-powered capabilities.
Build responsive, scalable, and user-friendly frontend applications.
Develop robust backend services, REST APIs, and integrations.
Integrate LLMs and generative AI models into production applications.
Build AI features such as chatbots, RAG systems, AI agents, document intelligence, summarization, classification, and content generation.
Work with vector databases and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Design and optimize database schemas and data-access layers.
Integrate third-party APIs, AI services, authentication systems, and external platforms.
Deploy and maintain applications on cloud platforms.
Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code.
Monitor application performance, reliability, and AI model quality.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver production-ready features.
Troubleshoot technical issues and continuously improve application performance and scalability.
Stay up to date with emerging AI, LLM, full-stack, and cloud technologies.
Required Skills
Frontend
Strong experience with React.js / Next.js.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.
Experience building responsive and reusable UI components.
Familiarity with modern frontend state-management and API-integration patterns.
Backend
Strong experience with Python (FastAPI/Django) and/or Node.js/TypeScript.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and scalable backend architecture.
Experience with asynchronous processing, background jobs, and third-party integrations.
AI / GenAI
Hands-on experience integrating OpenAI or other LLM APIs.
Strong understanding of LLM application development.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and semantic search.
Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, or pgvector.
Experience with AI frameworks/tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and AI evaluation.
Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows is a plus.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, model evaluation, or open-source LLMs is an advantage.
Databases
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases is a plus.
Experience with Redis/caching is desirable.
Understanding of database optimization and indexing.
Cloud & DevOps
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows.
Understanding of cloud architecture, logging, monitoring, and application security.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
25 years of professional software development experience.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good understanding of software development best practices and system design.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills and ownership mindset.

high.description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in modern full-stack development and experience integrating AI/ML models, LLMs, and cloud-native services into scalable business applications.
The role involves building AI-powered web applications, integrating LLM APIs, developing robust backend services, creating intuitive user interfaces, and ensuring seamless deployment across cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Full Stack Development

- Design and develop scalable web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
- Build responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using Python (FastAPI/Django) and Node.js.
- Ensure secure, high-performance, and maintainable application architecture.
Generative AI Integration

- Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models into enterprise applications.
- Develop AI-powered features including chatbots, virtual assistants, document intelligence, content generation, and recommendation systems.

Cloud & DevOps

- Containerize applications using Docker and orchestrate deployments with Kubernetes.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
- Ensure application scalability, reliability, and security.
API & Integration

- Integrate third-party APIs, AI services, vector databases, and enterprise systems.
- Develop event-driven and microservices-based architectures.
- Work with streaming solutions and real-time communication protocols where required.

high.title: Junior Software Engineer (SDE I)
high.description:
Software Engineer / Full-Stack Developer (SDE I — Freshers & Early Career) — Discorder.tools


Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)
Department: Engineering & Product

About the Role
discorder.tools is a fast-growing utility platform built for millions of Discord users, creators, moderators, and developers worldwide, offering instant browser-based tools like ID lookups, snowflake decoders, timestamp generators, and AI-driven community utilities. We are looking for energetic, driven, and quick-learning Software Engineers (SDE I) to join our product team. If you love building slick, high-performance web applications, micro-utilities, and tools that scale rapidly, this is your launchpad. 


Freshers with strong project portfolios and engineers with 0 to 2 years of experience are strongly encouraged to apply!

What You Will Do

- Build fast, responsive, and intuitive user interfaces and browser-based tools using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- Develop backend lookup services, API integrations, and fast utility processing scripts using Python or Node.js.
- Work directly with web APIs, performance optimization, and clean client-side state management.
- Collaborate with product teams to ship new community utilities, bot helper tools, and AI-powered text features.
- Write clean code, handle feedback rapidly, and help scale our platform infrastructure as traffic spikes.

What We Are Looking For

- 0 to 2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, or full-time roles).
- Solid foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python/Node.js, and core computer science fundamentals.
- Familiarity or hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (React / Next.js).
- High energy, a "get things done" startup mindset, and an eye for clean, minimalist user interfaces.
- Ability to work from our Bengaluru office in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment.

Tech Stack You Will Use

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Python / Node.js, REST APIs
- Tools & Infrastructure: Git, GitHub, Vercel / Cloud Hosting

Compensation & Perks

- Base Salary Range: ₹10,00,000 – ₹18,00,000 per annum (based on capability and project portfolio).
- Perks: Direct mentorship from senior engineers, rapid career growth in a high-traffic product startup, and flexible hybrid work culture in Bengaluru.

Day-to-Day Activities

- Maintain continuous professional development in full-stack engineering, AI code generation, prompt engineering, application security, testing, cloud technologies, and modern development practices. 

Professional Competencies



- Apply critical thinking, structured analysis, and practical problem-solving to resolve application, API, database, performance, and production issues. 
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to code reviews, engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and delivery outcomes. 
- Communicate technical requirements, implementation decisions, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
- Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, development practices, and delivery priorities while maintaining code quality and reliability. 
- Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, user experience, development efficiency, automation, reusability, security, and sustainable technology use. 
- Prioritize and manage development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and deployment activities while meeting agreed timelines.
